similarRejected.title: Allow replacing the internal dictionary with a custom subclass to support non-hashable keys
reasons: You can't subclass cache since it's a function and the relevant functionality, make_key, isn't available to override. You therefore need to either fork it, or reimplement...
An alternative approach would be to allow replacing `dict` with your own subclass. Then you could do the extension in a general way in the dict's `__getattr__` and `__setattr__`.
